balls.text: tries to sweep it away again, gets nowhere near the middle and they come back for another two, the fourth of the over!
dropped, Laxmi Ratan Shukla has floored it. Sweep shot attempted and it went high in the air and should have been caught, instead he fails to hold on.
outside the off stump, quicker and he tries to hit it over long-off, gets a couple of runs
shorter and wanted to pull it, gets a thick inside edge for a couple
tries to reverse sweep it, an aggressive reverse sweep in fact, misses it, so does the wicket-keeper and they get a single
shorter, off spinner, tries to cut but goes to the cover fielder for a single
outside the off-stump, pitched full and cannot get under it, drives to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the batsman and Morkel drills it back to the bowler, goes through and it is fielded well by Tiwary, who runs from long-off to behind the bowler.
good length and it keeps really low, gets an inside edge and they are off for a single to square-leg
one-handed four! There was no third-man in place and he delivers a full-toss outside the off-stump, drilled through that region for a boundary
pitched right up to the bat, slower, Dhoni checked his stroke well and hit it to wide long-on, both were intent on two and they do well to get it.
round the stumps, pitched up, driven to the off side for a single
gone, caught! Jadeja tries to go over the top, gets a lot of height, went up there for a long time and it was well caught at long-on by the time it came down. It was a slow, off-spinner from Narine
tries to play it to the leg-side gets a leading edge to the covers for a single
punched to the off side for a single
off-spinner, goes for a cut but the bounce defeats the stroke
on the off stump, no turn there and it is punched away to the off side for a single
on his pads, tries to sweep it, gets an edge and it goes to long-on for a couple of runs
yorker length and dug out well by Dhoni, played to the off side and they are off for a single
on his pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single.
slower one, Dhoni was winding up, brought his bat down quickly to the leg side for a single
pitched right up, tries to launch it long-on, gets an inside edge and it runs away to deep square-leg region for a couple
swept away, yes you read it right, swept to mid-wicket for a couple of runs. It is the same bowler who bowled the first ball too, Lee!
shot, first four in 47 balls for Chennai! A lot of width, pitched right up and placed away through the left of point for a four
good length delivery outside the off stump, Dhoni defends and they are off for a single
pitched up, and gets some bounce, he goes on to the back foot, defended back
goes on to the back foot and cut away, finds the gap this time for a single
shorter, turning away from the batsman from outside the leg stump and played away for a couple of runs to deep square-leg
pitched up this time, going straight on, cut to the covers again
short ball, turning away and he tries to cut it away, straight to the fielder
cut away to the short third-man for a single. Six singles off the over.
on his pads, fingers rolled over and Dhoni tries to flick it away, can get only to deep square-leg
pitched up, quicker this time and driven to long-off for a single
on his pads, slower, tries to force it through the leg side but can get only a leg-bye
on the pads, flick it away to the square-leg for a single
pitched right up, tries to slog it to long-on, but straight to the fielder and he gets a single
on the front foot, defended with an open bat to the off side and they are off for a single.
on the middle, turning away, driven to short covers
on the pads, tries to work it away and they are able to rotate it back
opens the face to hit it inside out, to the left of short covers for another quick single
defended on the front foot and the bowler runs across to field
defended on the front foot, rushes off for a quick single
gone, out, caught! Raina welt for a slog, a heave that he loves playing but it goes high in the air, Pathan comes over at mid-wicket and while there is a bit of a bobble, he manages to hold on to it.
goes down the pitch, tries to pull it away and only gets some edge, hard into the ground to deep square for a single
gives himself room and drives to long-off for a single
slower bouncer, tries to upper cut it but misses
pitched right up and Dhoni still goes on to the back foot and nudged away to the leg side for a single
on the middle and that is beautifully driven straight for a single, they could have come back for the second
full-toss ball and Dhoni wants to flick it away for a four over short fine-leg, but misses it completely and the bowler goes for an lbw appeal.
outside the off stump, bottom edge through to third-man for another couple of runs
not a good ball, on his pads, Dhoni taps it away to the deep square-leg region, where Lee tidies up and they come back for a second. It looked like it was a four...
outside the leg-stump, slower and tapped away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, very slow, Dhoni wanted to play the cut but the slowness of the ball makes him mistime the stroke and it goes to the right of short cover, misfield and a single
on the middle, punched down the ground for a single.
on the stumps, opens the face and guides the ball through the third-man for a single
short again, tries to pull it, gets a bottom edge on to his thigh pad and they go for a single this time
quicker one, on the middle, good length, punched back to the bowler
short ball to begin with, probably an inside edge off the pull shot, goes to the first slip which is in place for the new batsman and he wanted a single. Sent back by Raina
on the pads, punched to long-on for a single

goes down the pitch and that is gone, caught! It was slower, he went to play over long-on, but did not get too much of a bat on that and it has gone straight to the fielder at long-on moving to his left.
length ball, driven through the covers for a single
stumping missed? He was jumping down the pitch, missed this down the leg side, probably blinded by the batsman McCullum fails to collect it. and it is also called a wide
outside the off stump, pitched up and he opens the face of the bat, wanted to beat the short third-man and the fielder dives to right to prevent any more than a single
on his pads, tapped away to square-leg who is in the circle.
on his pads, pitched up and he tries to flick it away through short fine-leg, straight to the fielder
driven over the top to long-off for a single
slower one, beaten for the pace, Raina was into his stroke and he needed to check it, but the shot is played over extra cover, get two and then an overthrow from Lee at long-off
another one that is pitched short, Bravo almost jumps on his back foot and taps it to the off side, don't think of a single
another bouncer and Bravo ducks yet again, this time it wasn't down the leg side and the umpire lets it go.
bouncer, ducked under it, going down the leg-side and called a wide.
slapped away but on the bounce to the fielder at deep cover! Went down the pitch to go over extra-cover.
slower, shorter, tries to cut it through point, but goes straight to the fielder
down the leg-side, slower, Raina took advantage of the poor direction, neatly tucks it away to fine-leg for a four!
good length, a bit of bounce, tapped away to third-man for a single
on his pads, played away to backward square-leg for a single, wanted a second but the fielder came around quickly to stall that possibility.
outside the off stump, on the up, punched back to long-off for a single
poor, poor ball, down the leg-side, also pitched right up and that is played over the short fine-leg fielder for a four. Raina seems to be overcoming the scratchiness from the previous games
pitched up this time, but on pads, driven through to deep square-leg for a couple
short of length and punched off the back foot to long-off for a single
on his pads and Raina flicks it away to deep square-leg for a single
shorter yet again, opens the face of the bat and gets something on it, goes through to third-man for a single
slower bouncer, Raina wanted to upper-guide it over the wicket-keeper, but does not get any bat on it.
outside the off stump, goes on to the back foot, opens the face of the bat and that goes through to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, good length, punched back to mid-off but that is fielded well.
opens the face of the bat and it goes through to third-man for a single
punched on the up and that goes through the covers for a four! That was a sparkling stroke and looked to have come from a man in form, which Raina isn't!
that is a walking six, use of a lot of wrists in that shot! Goes down the pitch and the ball was on his pads, he plays on with the momentum and it goes over the deep mid-wicket fence for maximum.
pitched on length and turning away from the bat, goes down the pitch to work it away, leading edge to the bowler
another one on the pads, turns further down the leg side and he plays it to deep square-leg for a single
swept away and that goes through backward square-leg for a four. Beats the square-leg and short fine-leg
outside the off stump, short of length and driven on the up, in the air for a while before it goes to short cover
on the leg side, quicker, driven towards mid-on and the bowler dives and fields

out, run-out! Hussey has been run-out, off the back-foot, forces it to the leg-side, Hussey wanted a single, runs halfway through and Raina refuses it. By the time Hussey realises the futility of going for that single, the ball has been thrown back to the wicket-keeper by Lee, who removes the bails.
a bit short from Narine, rocks back and pushes it through the covers for four!
outside the off stump and turning a lot from there, beaten
on the leg stump, bit of turn but smothered by a front foot defensive that goes to mid-off
on the back-foot, tries to force it away to the leg side and they want a quick single, Lee throws it to the non-striker, misses.
outside the off-stump, turning away, tries a cut, beaten
pitched up this time, driven to mid-off, where the captain misfields and the pair is off for a couple
now, now, is that a cricket shot? It was short of good length, 136 km/hr, and Raina has played it with a straight, vertical bat, off the front foot over long-off!
fullish ball, on the middle stump and driven straight, mid-off comes over and fields.
this time he pitches right up to the bat and Hussey tries to drive it, gets the toe end of the bat, races away to the third-man fence, Narine dives and saves the boundary
pitched right up to the batsman and defended on the front foot, on the off side but does not get a single
that is a carbon copy of that stroke he played off the first ball of Lee's previous over! short, wanted to pull, no bounce and that goes through to the wicket-keeper
on the pads of the batsman, but fullish, played it away to the leg side for a single
outside the off-stump and pitched right up, left alone by Hussey.
pitched right up to the bat and tries to hit it inside out, ends up playing a lofted mistimed shot to long-off
pitched right up to the bat and driven well, but straight to the cover fielder
outside edge and that is nearly a catch. Oh no, that is nearly a four. No it is both actually, clears the short third-man and almost rolls over for a four, saved well.
compensates by pitching right up, but down the leg side and it is a wide.
shortish ball and that is worked away to square-leg, goes into the gap and four!
short this time and defended on the back-foot. Some words off the previous delivery.
pitched up, outside the off stump and is very tentative, misses the edge. No foot movement, probably because of the short-leg fielder who is present.

Appeal for a catch behind, but did that carry? Yes it does! Short ball and Faff played the same shot that Hussey tried off the first ball, the difference was that he did get some bat to it and it has gone straight into the wicket-keeper's gloves!
length ball, defended and it rolls back on the bounce to the wicket-keeper, who fails to hold on to it because of the bounce and they are able to get away for a single
pitched up this time after that short ball last time, gets an inside edge but luckily for him, it goes  back into his pads.
short of length, tries to pull it away! Misses and goes through to the wicket-keeper. Lack of bounce did not help matters.
on the leg stump, slight turn, nurdled away to backward square-leg for a single
on the middle, length ball, defended back
turning into the batsman, quick one too, on length and he was on the back foot. Works it to short fine leg and wanted a single, sent back
on the pads, tapped away to square-leg and they are off for a quick single. The throw came at the non-striker's end.
pitched up again and spinning away, nudged away to the covers
pitched right up, outside the off stump, driven through extra cover, to wide long-off and they come back for a couple
shot, four, end of the match! That is an excellent shot under pressure from Das and he has been dispatched to mid-wicket for a four.
in the air, and caught! Pathan tried to slog sweep it, top edged it away and du Plessis takes a simple catch! Match is alive despite the obvious possibility of one stroke finishing it.
tossed up, wanted to slog it away, missed completely! Dot!
that is a leg-spinner, a tad shorter and Pathan read it well, cuts it and goes to the deep point region where Yo Mahes does a good job with the fielding but cannot prevent two.
yorker, drilled to long-on and it is the end of Bravo's spell, a bitter-sweet last over.
pitched up outside the off stump, tries to get under it, gets a bit of an edge, rolls to long-off and they are able to come back for the second because of the mistimed stroke.
full-toss, outside the off stump and drilled to the covers for a single
pitched up, slower, outside the off stump and he tries to hit it over the extra-cover, mistimed but they come back for the second. Pathan wanted the third too...
full-toss and on pads, the new batsman, Das, puts him away to the place it needed to be, flicked to fine-leg for a four!
gone, lbw! Pitched right up, slower, missed that slog shot did Gambhir and it hits the pads, loud shot and the umpire upholds the appeal, rightly so as well.
short ball, pulled really well by the batsman, but the field is on the fence on the leg side, it goes straight to deep mid-wicket and they take a single. Six off the over.
defends on the front foot, opens the face of the bat and easily rotates the strike.
Gambhir tries to mow it across the line and there was a huge appeal there for an lbw. It seemed to be going down the leg-side, or so I think anyway.
short ball, goes on to the back foot, driven to the long-on fielder for a single
short, cut away, gets an outside edge and it goes flying on the bounce to Michael Hussey at short third-man, they are still through
quicker, carrom ball from Ashwin, Pathan sees it to his bat, taps it to the off side for a single
flicks it away easily for a single, end of Morkel's four overs.
pitched up on the pads, tapped gently to the mid-wicket region for a quick single.
pitched right up, on the front foot, defended, inside edge for a single
on the middle, dabbed away gently to mid-on and they call each other for a second. The bowler had to run for this one and the batsmen are able to make it in time.
drifts on his pads, probably deliberately to cramp him for room, played away to the leg side for a single
flicked away and the slower one seems to have beaten him, goes into the hands of the short square-leg fielder, three down and an outside hope of a twist in the tale.
flicked away to the leg-side, down to deep square-leg for a single. Easy going.
inside out, goes to the sweeper for a single to GG
on the back foot, tries to flick it away yet again, and gets a single
tries to flick it away, hits the pads
slog swept away by Tiwary for a four! Raina's going for some runs here...
shortish, forced away to the leg side and takes a couple of runs to deep square-leg.
did I say the track was not conducive for stroke play? Scratch it! Short and pulled away by Gambhir and that goes over the mid-wicket region for another four!
through the covers for a four, shot in anger and through the short cover for a four!
short ball, 135.2 km/hr, flicked away to backward square-leg for a single
short ball, hit well, pulled and they get a single to bring up his fourth 50 this IPL. Wanted the second but sent back.
played away to the leg side for a single.
short, edged? There was a huge appeal there, for an inside-edge to the wicket-keeper. Given not-out.
goes on to the back foot, nudges it away for a single.
short, outside the off stump and Gambhir cuts it to the left of the cover fielder for a single
gives a little room, cuts but to point and they get another one
cuts it off the middle stump, well played in the end, but only for a single.
a shot in frustration, punched through the the right of short cover and they are able to come back for a second
tries to cut it away, goes to point, wanted to go for the single and that is another run-out missed!
on his pads, tries to flick it away, gets hit on the pad and they are off for a leg-bye
defended on the back foot, played away to the leg side for a single
run-out missed! on the back-foot, defended, Tiwary took a couple of steps, Gambhir took 10 and by the time he turned back, the throw had come. Does not hit the stumps.
edged and caught! Goes down the track, wanted to drive it, gets a bottom edge, Dhoni takes it easily and Kolkata have lost their second.
short one, again some pace on that one, and Jakati at short mid-wicket jumped high, but fails to get a hand on that one. It came on to GG quicker than he thought it would
pitched up, down the leg side, hits the pad and rolls over to the leg side, they are off for a quick one.
full pitched, driven to the long-on fielder for a single
shorter, outside the off stump, turning away and cut away for a single
slog swept away to deep mid-wicket for a single, on the bounce to Hussey
goes down the pitch yet again but this time he has lofted it through mid-wicket for a four
down the pitch but driven back to the bowler
on the middle stump, driven to the leg side for short mid-wicket to field
tries to paddle it, delicately scoops it away through fine-leg and that needs some good fielding by Badrinath to stop the four. Poor running though, should have been a third there.
fullish yet again, plays it inside-out over extra cover for a couple of runs.
goes down the leg stump to give himself room, drives to long-off for another run.
sees him coming down, sends it down quicker and cut away for a single
another one that is fullish, driven to mid-off for another single
pitched up, driven but back to the bowler
outside the off stump, slapped away to the deep cover fielder for a single. Only four from the over.
keeps a little low that, outside the off stump and Kallis is beaten by that, goes through to the wicket-keeper
short ball, came quickly on to Gambhir, unleashes the pull shot and that goes to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
length ball yet again, punched to the covers for a single
stood tall and wanted to cut it away, missed the good length ball and it goes through to the wicket-keeper
outside the off-stump, slower, cut away to the third-man fielder for a single
from outside the off-stump, drilled through deep mid-wicket for a single. Doing this comfortably here Kolkata.
fullish, outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
that is a silly, cheeky shot, Outside the off-stump, wanted to paddle it, before deciding to open the face, gets it on the full, flies to the short third-man, just short
outside the off stump, quicker one and it another wide.
outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single.
this time round the wicket, on the pads, played away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, dabbed away to the off side.
short ball on the pads, and it keeps really low, still Gambhir easily works it away to fine-leg for a single
slashed away through point, four, not very well-controlled, eluding the point fielder du Plessis, but he gets those four.
nudged to the leg side, they go for a quick one, and the fielder hits the stumps direct from short fine-leg, the third ump called, but he was quite well in.
full-toss and down the leg side, wide. It has been a tale of bowling a lot of them down the leg side and an equal number of chances missed by the batsman to get a four!
goes down the wicket, gave him the charge, bowled down the leg side, and that is the sixth wide of the innings
tapped away to the off side and they are off for a quick single. Doing it well so far.
on his pads, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up and driven to the deep point fielder for a single
pitched right up and driven to wide long-on for a single
down the pitch and deposited! Went over the wicket this time, Gambhir strolled out of the crease and lofted it over long-on for a six!
short, wide and Kallis punches it through the covers for a single.
outside the off stump, quicker, tries to cut it, but straight to point
goes down the pitch, dabs it down to the leg side for a single
full-toss driven to wide long-on for a single
another one on the pads, hits Gambhir, wanted to go for a single, went straight to Dhoni, who throws it at the striker's stumps. No harm done, no single taken.
another wide, poor bowling from Morkel, down the leg side and Gambhir just needed to get some bat on it and it would have gone for four. Gambhir missed but the umpire did not miss calling it a wide.
on his pads, tapped away to the leg side for a single
short, wide and Kallis wanted to cut it, seeing it was slower, tries to drive it but mistimes it.
short again, he goes down the pitch and that ball goes over his shoulder I think, that was the second for the over and the umpire calls it a no-ball
short, bouncer and that is way above the batsman's head, easy call of a wide
tries to give himself room, backs away and drives to short mid-wicket for a single
gives himself room, goes for a cut shot, misses and it goes through to the wicket-keeper. That was a quicker one, Gambhir still feeling that bouncer that hit his head?
on the off-stump, punched to the off side, dived to his right did the point fielder and allows only a single
fuller on the leg stump and that is whipped away to the leg side for another single
shortish, Gambhir rocks back and takes a single to mid-off
Oooh, missed! Run-out missed, had it been a direct hit, Kallis was going home. Quick single attempted to mid-off, but he was falling short.
defended on the leg side
slogged swept away for a six! Kallis seemed to be fed up by all those fielders around he has swept him over deep square-leg
pitched right up, turning slightly away, driven to wide mid-off for a single
outside the off stump, defended to point and that ends a strange over, full of deliveries that should have gone to the fence and yet only six from it.
on his pads again and played away to the short fine-leg for a single. Leg-bye called.
outside the off stump yet again and Gambhir tries to cut it, but goes to the point region.
four in the V, but behind the stumps! tries to cut it, gets an under edge and it bounces over Dhoni for a four
third ball down the leg side and third time he misses a boundary, tries to flick it, gets some bat but Dhoni dives on his right.
down the leg side yet again, this time he misses it altogether, but it is a wide
shorter ball, on his pads, could be a bit upset not to get it through the short fine-leg for a four
goes on to the back foot, defended on the onside, near the bat, Dhoni collects on the bounce and pushes it back to the stumps
spinning and viciously at that, off-spinner down the leg-side though and it is called a wide

gone, caught! Ashwin had clearly got the better of McCullum in that over and he failed to read him on both the previous two deliveries, this time he comes down the track, it was the carrom-ball and he only manages to scoop it to mid-off.
defended it on the off side for nothing
that is a ripper, the carrom ball, totally deceives the batsman. The previous one was spinning in, this goes away and hits the pads, loud appeal, given not out
turn and bounce into the batsman and McCullum looks a bit baffled...
comes on to the front foot, defends it to the leg side
good length, on the off-stump, keeps low as Gambhir tries to hit it on the up, straight to the covers.
slower, bouncer, but down the leg side, Gambhir wanted to go over fine-leg, missed and it is called a wide
shortish, width and that is cut hard through the point region. He was trying this before but finally gets it in the gap
on his pads, tapped away to the deep square-leg for a single
outside the off-stump, tries to cut the ball away, gets it off the middle and it was well fielded by point, almost well fielded...
bouncer, was coming down the pitch and that has smashed Gambhir on his helmet. The helmet's sticker has flown away...!
short of length, tries to cut it away but straight to point
defended on the front foot, back to the bowler
on the pads, tapped to the wide long-on region and they again took a single, wanted two but resist that temptation.
goes on to the back foot, pushes it away to the leg side for a single
goes down the pitch and drives it to long-on for a single, wanted a second, but refused
shorter, tries to cut it away, goes to point
full-toss to a man in form and that has been driven through the covers for a four! Poor, poor ball that.
